description: CR 608.2d Ajani's Chosen offers no attach for an Aura that can't enchant the Cat
note: Wild Growth enters on alice's Forest and Ajani's Chosen makes a Cat. An enchant-land Aura can't legally enchant a creature (CR 303.4j), so no host the instruction could choose moves it (CR 701.3b) and the "you may" is not offered (an unscheduled prompt would fail this run). ajanis-chosen-makes-a-cat-and-moves-an-aura-onto-it is the twin that is offered.
